name: Experiment Protocol
description: Structured experimental workflow from hypothesis through reporting. Human-driven execution with engine-assisted analysis.

parameters.name: hypothesis
parameters.description: The hypothesis to test (e.g., 'Compound X inhibits enzyme Y at 10μM').

parameters.name: sampleSize
parameters.description: Target sample size for the experiment.

taskTemplates.title: Define hypothesis: {{hypothesis}}
taskTemplates.description: Formalize the hypothesis, identify variables (independent, dependent, controlled), and state expected outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Hypothesis clearly stated in testable form

taskTemplates.title: Design experiment for {{hypothesis}}
taskTemplates.description: Create experimental protocol using {{methodology}} approach with n={{sampleSize}}. Include controls, randomization, and blinding.

taskTemplates.title: Execute experiment
taskTemplates.description: Run the experiment following the protocol. Record all observations, deviations, and raw data.

taskTemplates.title: Analyze experimental results
taskTemplates.description: Perform statistical analysis on collected data. Generate visualizations and test hypothesis.

taskTemplates.title: Write experiment report
taskTemplates.description: Draft a report covering methods, results, and conclusions. Include all figures and tables.
acceptanceCriteria: Report follows standard structure (intro, methods, results, discussion)
